description: This file contains tests for the EventEmitter class, specifically testing prependListener and prependOnceListener methods, as well as validation of listener argument types.

classes.name: EventEmitter
classes.description: A class implementing event handling with methods to add listeners, including prepend methods.

methods.name: prependListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to the beginning of the listeners array for the specified event.

methods.name: prependOnceListener
methods.description: Adds a one-time listener to the beginning of the listeners array for the specified event.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Emits an event, invoking all listeners associated with it.
